builds.gear_notes: Although reliant on Bleed, Crit Rate & Crit DMG are still important multipliers for dealing pure DMG to bosses. Although ATK% allows for more (but not significantly more) Bleed DMG, overall the results lead to slower runs if Crits do not happen.

dedicated.name: Bi Dam's Golden Crown

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Bi Dam by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"But... I am currently on a mission by order of the Princess..."
"I am well aware of that. But surely, you realize that I cannot go at this alone!"

Bi Dam encountered Lee Jung in a village left in ruins by an attack from Black Magicians. Lee Jung pleaded with him to help find the abducted sages and his missing daughter, Nezha. Despite being in the midst of carrying out the Princess's mission, Bi Dam accepted Lee Jung's earnest plea. As a token of his gratitude, Lee Jung presented Bi Dam with a small golden crown and bid him farewell as he saw him off on his journey.

lore:
Born into a successful military family, Bi Dam trained from a young age to become a career soldier.
At the top of his already elite class, he was well aware that he was born to be a leader, and he tried hard to fit himself into that mold.
Even from a young age, he was the center of the Hwarang. No one could come close to challenging his position as their next leader.
Yet a windfall found its way to the young leader — a large group of bandits attacked the village he was stationed in.
He lured them into traps to scatter them and used his exceptional archery skills to capture their leader.
This display of wisdom and combat prowess earned Bi Dam recognition from the other Hwarang, so he gradually began to take over the responsibilities left by Yu Shin. In time, Bi Dam officially became the leader of the Hwarang, and led the group into a new era.
Under his leadership, the focus of the Hwarang has shifted. When the Hwarang were led by Yu Shin, they had mostly committed themselves to defeating monsters and the supernatural, but under Bi Dam, their duties extended to cleaning out bandit groups and suppressing various rebellions.
This led to Lee Jung highly praising Bi Dam's leadership, but Yu Shin is disappointed by the Hwarang's involvement in conflicts between humans.
